# Hidden worker, fired from oe_tcd.4 and oe_tcd.5: walks the jurisdiction locations of the flagged provinces.
oe_tcd.9 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_tcd.9.t
    trigger = { tag = BYZ }
    immediate = {
        every_subject = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tcd_job_reg }
            remove_variable = oe_tcd_job_reg
            oe_tcd_apply_register = yes
        }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tcd_job_unrest }
            remove_variable = oe_tcd_job_unrest
            every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_tcd_flight_loc years = 2 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
}
